consequences.production: One target-independent adversary forces (1-epsilon_n) I(R) comparisons, epsilon_n -> 0, where I(R)=log(n!)-log e(R).
consequences.prefix_count: For each fixed stage k, log T_q >= log(n!) - (1+O(log k/k))q for every completed comparison prefix. T_q counts all orders consistent with the transcript.
consequences.initial_partial_order: Compatible weak-order extension and independent layer adversaries at the common ambient parameter k(n) force (1-o(1))log e(P)-O(n log log n) comparisons.
consequences.exact_sampling: For fixed degree d and directed-height bound h, an adjacency-list DAG admits exact uniform linear-extension sampling in O(n log n) expected arithmetic operations and fair random bits.
